Subject: Re: Updated procurement timeline + ask on stage classification

Hi Mary — thanks for the files and the heads-up. Quick note from our side:

- For DW-9427 we currently have a 'sales commit' in the system (pending legal/compliance sign-off).
- Finance treats an invoiceable commit as when contracts and KYC/KMS attestations are complete.

Proposed approach (so Procurement has a clear trigger):
1) Mark the opportunity as "Commit-Lighthouse" when sponsor & legal ack exist (soft commit visibility for forecasting).
2) Move to "Finance-Committed" only after DocuSign + KMS proof and SOC2 evidence are uploaded.

Vanessa / Karthik — can you confirm we can map the 'Commit-Lighthouse' label into the forecast sheet and whether CS should be listed as the verification owner for the KMS checks?

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
